The code statements that lead to the bug are:
```java
GlobalSectionData gData = jobConf.get(OOZIE_GLOBAL) == null ? null : getGlobalFromString(jobConf.get(OOZIE_GLOBAL));
if (!serializedGlobalConf && elem.getName().equals(SubWorkflowActionExecutor.ACTION_TYPE) &&
        elem.getChild(("propagate-configuration"), ns) != null) {
```
Reason:
The bug occurs because `gData` is assigned a value that can be `null` if there is no global section in the job configuration. When the code attempts to access `gData` without checking if it is `null`, it leads to a NullPointerException (NPE) when the `propagate-configuration` is present.

The code statements that fix the bug are:
```java
if (!serializedGlobalConf && elem.getName().equals(SubWorkflowActionExecutor.ACTION_TYPE) &&
        elem.getChild(("propagate-configuration"), ns) != null && gData != null) {
```
Reason:
The fix adds a null check for `gData` in the conditional statement. This ensures that the code only attempts to access `gData` if it is not `null`, thereby preventing the NullPointerException when submitting a SubWorkflow action without a global section.
